armorNote: Druids refuse to wear armor or use shields made of metal.

features.name: Druidic
features.summary: You know the secret druid language and can leave hidden messages in it; others notice such a message with a DC 15 Wis (Perception) check but can't read it without magic.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.summary: Full Wisdom caster preparing Wis mod + druid level (min 1) spells daily from the druid list; ritual casting for prepared rituals; druidic focus as spellcasting focus.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.summary: Action: turn into a beast you have seen, for up to half your druid level in hours. Max CR 1/4 with no fly/swim speed at 2nd; CR 1/2, no fly at 4th; CR 1 at 8th. You take the beast's HP and stats but keep mental scores and can't cast spells.

features.name: Druid Circle
features.summary: Join the Circle of the Land or the Circle of the Moon; the circle grants features at 2nd, 6th, 10th and 14th level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: At 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, add +2 to one ability or +1 to two abilities (max 20).

features.name: Timeless Body
features.summary: You age only one year for every ten that pass.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.summary: You can cast druid spells while in Wild Shape, supplying verbal and somatic components but not material ones.

features.name: Archdruid
features.summary: Wild Shape uses become unlimited, and you can skip verbal, somatic and costless non-consumed material components of druid spells in any form.

choices.name: Beast Shapes: 2nd level
choices.summary: Max CR 1/4; no flying or swimming speed (e.g. wolf).

choices.name: Beast Shapes: 4th level
choices.summary: Max CR 1/2; no flying speed (e.g. crocodile).

choices.name: Beast Shapes: 8th level
choices.summary: Max CR 1; no movement restriction (e.g. giant eagle).

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.summary: Learn one extra druid cantrip of your choice.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.summary: During a short rest, recover expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your druid level (rounded up); no slot of 6th level or higher.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.summary: Choose the land you were initiated in; gain its two circle spells at druid levels 3, 5, 7 and 9. They are always prepared, don't count against prepared spells and count as druid spells.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.summary: Nonmagical difficult terrain costs no extra movement; pass through nonmagical plants unslowed and unharmed; advantage on saves against magical plants that hinder movement (e.g. entangle).

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.summary: Elementals and fey can't charm or frighten you, and you are immune to poison and disease.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.summary: A beast or plant attacking you must pass a Wis save vs. your spell DC or pick another target (or miss). On a success it is immune for 24 hours; it knows of this effect beforehand.

choices.name: Arctic
choices.summary: 3: Hold Person, Spike Growth; 5: Sleet Storm, Slow; 7: Freedom of Movement, Ice Storm; 9: Commune with Nature, Cone of Cold

choices.name: Coast
choices.summary: 3: Mirror Image, Misty Step; 5: Water Breathing, Water Walk; 7: Control Water, Freedom of Movement; 9: Conjure Elemental, Scrying

choices.name: Desert
choices.summary: 3: Blur, Silence; 5: Create Food and Water, Protection from Energy; 7: Blight, Hallucinatory Terrain; 9: Insect Plague, Wall of Stone

choices.name: Forest
choices.summary: 3: Barkskin, Spider Climb; 5: Call Lightning, Plant Growth; 7: Divination, Freedom of Movement; 9: Commune with Nature, Tree Stride

choices.name: Grassland
choices.summary: 3: Invisibility, Pass without Trace; 5: Daylight, Haste; 7: Divination, Freedom of Movement; 9: Dream, Insect Plague

choices.name: Mountain
choices.summary: 3: Spider Climb, Spike Growth; 5: Lightning Bolt, Meld into Stone; 7: Stone Shape, Stoneskin; 9: Passwall, Wall of Stone

choices.name: Swamp
choices.summary: 3: Darkness, Melf's Acid Arrow; 5: Water Walk, Stinking Cloud; 7: Freedom of Movement, Locate Creature; 9: Insect Plague, Scrying

choices.name: Underdark
choices.summary: 3: Spider Climb, Web; 5: Gaseous Form, Stinking Cloud; 7: Greater Invisibility, Stone Shape; 9: Cloudkill, Insect Plague

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.summary: Wild Shape takes a bonus action instead of an action. While transformed, bonus action: spend a spell slot to regain 1d8 HP per slot level.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.summary: Wild Shape max CR becomes 1 at 2nd level (ignore the Beast Shapes CR column but keep its movement limits), and druid level / 3 (rounded down) from 6th level.

features.name: Primal Strike
features.summary: Your beast-form attacks count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

features.name: Elemental Wild Shape
features.summary: Spend two Wild Shape uses at once to become an air, earth, fire or water elemental.

discrepancies: Circle of the Moon has an EMPTY features array in the app; all five PHB features are missing: Combat Wild Shape (2), Circle Forms (2; max CR 1 at 2nd, then druid level / 3 from 6th: 2/3/4/5/6 at 6/9/12/15/18), Primal Strike (6), Elemental Wild Shape (10), Thousand Forms (14).

Circle of the Land: the app has 7 level-2 placeholder features 'Circle of the Land: Arctic/Coast/Desert/Forest/Grassland/Mountain/Swamp' that all just repeat the circle's flavor text and contain NO circle spell lists; 'Circle Spells' is repeated at 3/5/7/9 with identical generic text. The terrain spell lists (2 spells at each of druid levels 3/5/7/9) are missing entirely, and the 'Circle of the Land' flavor paragraph is itself listed as a level-2 feature.

Circle of the Land: this PHB printing includes an 8th terrain, Underdark (Spider Climb, Web / Gaseous Form, Stinking Cloud / Greater Invisibility, Stone Shape / Cloudkill, Insect Plague), and the Circle Spells text names it among the choices; the app has no Underdark option.

Progression `special.wild_shape_max_cr` is 1 at level 7, but the book's Beast Shapes table only allows CR 1 from 8th level (level 7 should be 0.5). Also no Moon override (CR 1 at 2nd, up to 6 at 18th) is modeled.

Limited-use resources are not modeled: Wild Shape (2 uses, recharge on short or long rest; unlimited at 20th via Archdruid), Natural Recovery (once per long rest, slot levels up to ceil(level/2), none 6th+), Moon's Elemental Wild Shape costing 2 Wild Shape uses.

Feature naming differs from the book: app splits Wild Shape into 'Wild Shape (CR 1/4 or below, no flying or swim speed)' / '(CR 1/2 or below, no flying speed)' / '(CR 1 or below)' where the book table says 'Wild Shape' at 2nd and 'Wild Shape improvement' at 4th and 8th; app uses 'Spellcasting: Druid' (book: 'Spellcasting').
Proficiencies: app omits the book's restriction that druids won't wear metal armor or use metal shields (minor, flavor/rules note).

Verified matching the book: hit die d8, saves Int/Wis, armor (light, medium, shields), weapons (club, dagger, dart, javelin, mace, quarterstaff, scimitar, sickle, sling, spear), Herbalism Kit, skill list (Arcana, Animal Handling, Insight, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Religion, Survival; choose 2), Wis casting, subclassLevel 2, proficiency bonus, cantrips known (2/3/4 at 1/4/10), and all spell slot counts for levels 1-20; Land features Bonus Cantrip, Natural Recovery, Land's Stride, Nature's Ward, Nature's Sanctuary are present at the correct levels.
